description: Injury and roster signal model plus verified example rows. The example rows below are real, sourced from the official NFL Injury Report (Week 10, 2026), fetched 2026-11-13. They demonstrate the starter/backup tracking schema. Full tracking requires the automated feed described in SU2; until then, only the official weekly report is verified. Depth-chart strings are confirmed against official team/league sources; third-party aggregators are used only as leads and are flagged.

signalModel.name: Offense starter/backup tracker
signalModel.detail: Tracks each offensive position group's 1st-string starter and 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups; flags when a backup is elevated to starter, recording the position and expected signal impact.

signalModel.name: Defense starter/backup tracker
signalModel.detail: Tracks each defensive position group's 1st-string starter and 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups; flags when a backup is elevated to starter and quantifies the defense-deficiency signal.

signalModel.name: Injury status feed
signalModel.detail: Ingests the official weekly injury report (player, position, injury, practice status, game status) and maps it to the depth tracker.

signalModel.name: Defense-deficiency signal
signalModel.detail: When a defensive starter is out/questionable and a backup starts, emits a defence-deficiency signal for the affected position group, to be combined with model inputs.
